t: You're facing St Saviour's, an Anglo-Catholic church at the north end of St George's Square in Pimlico. It went up in the 1860s as part of Thomas Cubitt's development of the area for the Marquess of Westminster. Look at the ragstone and the Gothic style. They were chosen to contrast with the classical stucco of the neighbouring houses. The designer was Thomas Cundy, who had already built St Gabriel's, a short distance away. The church is Grade II listed.
